data.summary:
A highly skilled and Seasoned Data Engineer with 5 years of experience specializing in resilient data architecture and
modernization. Deep expertise in transforming complex data challenges into robust, real-time solutions, leveraging Apache Spark
for high-throughput processing. Proficient across major cloud platforms including AWS and Azure, Skilled in Python and SQL for
development, coupled with DevOps practices to ensure continuous integration and deployment of critical data platforms.

raw_sections.summary:
A highly skilled and Seasoned Data Engineer with 5 years of experience specializing in resilient data architecture and
modernization. Deep expertise in transforming complex data challenges into robust, real-time solutions, leveraging Apache Spark
for high-throughput processing. Proficient across major cloud platforms including AWS and Azure, Skilled in Python and SQL for
development, coupled with DevOps practices to ensure continuous integration and deployment of critical data platforms.
raw_sections.skills: SKILLS Big Data Frameworks - Apache Spark, PySpark, Scala Spark, Hadoop (HDFS, Hive). Languages - Python, Scala, SQL (Advanced), Bash, Shell, Java, Javascript. Cloud Computing - AWS (S3, Athena, RDS, EC2, EMR), Azure (ADLS, Databricks, Synapse), GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow) Workflow Orchestration - Apache Airflow, DevOps & CI/CD, Docker, Grafana, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, GitLab.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Nielsen Media | 2024 - Current | Senior Data Engineer
Tech Stack - Pyspark, Scala, AWS S3, RDS, EC2, SQS, Airflow, Sql, Postgress, Kubernatics, Docker
Led the end-to-end migration of a legacy on-premise data project to AWS, leveraging Scala and Spark to improve
system scalability and performance, ensuring a seamless decommissioning of old hardware.
Engineered Big Data Solutions: Designed, implemented, and optimized high-performance ETL/ELT data pipelines
responsible for processing Terabyte-scale digital advertising campaign data, ensuring accurate measurement and
reporting.
Workflow Orchestration: Managed and maintained over 45 mission-critical data workflows using Apache Airflow,
dramatically improving process reliability and reducing manual intervention.
Data Modeling & Persistence: Developed robust analytical data models in Scala Spark and managed production
PostgreSQL instances, tuning schemas and queries to maximize retrieval efficiency for downstream Apps.
Automated Delivery: Implemented and managed CI/CD pipelines via GitLab, automating code testing and
deployment to accelerate release cycles and enforce high standards of code quality.
PriceWaterHouse Copper (PWC) | 2022-2024 | Senior Consultant DE | Client Adobe
Tech Stack - Pyspark, Scala, MySql, Azure Databricks, Airflow, Shell Scripting, Delta Lake, Grafana
Product Analytics & Insights: Engineered a comprehensive "Top Pages" ETL pipeline that transformed raw granular
data into actionable product insights; enabled the Product team to identify high-conversion user journeys and
optimize page performance.
Managed the end-to-end data pipeline for the Adobe Main Home Page, processing petabyte-scale click-level data
that was initially streamed in real-time and then consumed for complex batch analytics and reporting..
Migrated Adobe’s On Premise Data from Hadoop to Spark and later migrated to Azure Cloud. Collaborated closely with data scientists to operationalize deeper insight in production pipelines. Communicated technical concepts effectively to stakeholders, ensuring alignment of data engineering efforts with business
objectives.
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | 2021-2022| Data Engineer | Client RBI
Tech Stack - Pyspark, Scala, MySql, Hadoop, Hive, Ozzie, Shell Scripting, Talend
Designed and implemented scalable ETL pipelines using Talend, PySpark, and SQL to process and integrate Banking
Data from across the country. Utilized Talend Data Integration Studio to design and deploy complex ETL jobs, ensuring efficient data extraction,
transformation, and loading processes. Developed custom components and reusable templates to streamline
development.
Migrated Data from RDBMS servers to On Prem Hadoop Ecosystem.
